description: This Java class 'FormFactory' is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model' package and provides methods for loading, creating, and managing forms defined in XML files within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles form configurations, caching, and retrieval from various sources such as classpath resources, web application context, and file locations.

classes.name: FormFactory
classes.description: A utility class responsible for loading, creating, and caching form models from XML resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getFormsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads all forms defined in an XML file specified by resourceName, returning a map of form names to ModelForm instances.

methods.name: getFormFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific form by name from a resource located at a given location, utilizing caching to improve performance.

methods.name: getFormFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a form by name from the web application's context, based on the HTTP request, with caching.

methods.name: readFormDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document containing form definitions and constructs ModelForm instances for each form element found.

methods.name: createModelForm
methods.description: Creates a ModelForm object from a Document or Element representing form configuration, deciding between form types.
